{{Quote|Wanted for the destruction of several Republic Security Force facilities.|Zeelesi's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Sobel Zeelesi''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, red head spines, and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Zeelesi had become affiliated with [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and was wanted for the destruction of several important [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] facilities. The security force issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] offering 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for their capture or 500 upon their [[Death/Legends|death]]. Zeelesi eventually became a thug for the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]]. The Rodian wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and wore a red [[shirt]] with gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and tan [[Clothing|pants]] with black shoes.<ref name="BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] visited Outland Station while hunting for Ghintee. During his pursuit of the criminal, Fett encountered Zeelesi alongside three [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]<ref name="BH" /> who were shouting at each other in a changing room.<ref name="Prima" /> The group of thugs attacked Fett but were dispatched and the hunter captured Zeelesi alive for the full sum of credits.<ref name="BH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sobel Zeelesi first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Zeelesi is the fourth optional bounty available to the player that can be captured alive for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that Jango Fett captured Zeelesi alive for the full sum of credits.
